name: Best Safe
tagline: Honest safe buying guides: the right home safe, gun safe or fireproof safe for what you need to protect.
description: Honest buying guides for home safes, gun safes and fireproof safes: handgun, document, wall, floor and vehicle safes and lock boxes, compared on lock type, steel, independent fire ratings, access speed and bolt-down options.

authors.name: Best Safe Editorial Team
authors.bio: We research home safes, gun safes and fireproof safes for people protecting firearms, documents and valuables: lock types (mechanical dial, electronic keypad, biometric, key), steel gauge, bolt work and pry resistance, independent fire ratings from UL or Intertek (ETL), how fast you can get in under stress, bolt-down options and legal storage rules. Every guide follows our published research process and editorial policy.
